title: Outlook: Data Loss Prevention (DLP) Policy Tips & Override in Outlook for Mac
description: Outlook for Mac now supports Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy tips, helping users avoid accidental data leaks. When sensitive content is detected, users are alerted with inline tips or pop-ups, based on admin-configured rules.
